notes: DPL is a hierarchy, not a flat point set: headquarters, zonal libraries, branch/special fixed libraries, sub-branches, one community library, and scheduled mobile service points. Google-derived coordinates are accepted for internal modelling here and must be flagged before publication. Branch-wise max seating capacity, opening hours, collection size, and collection-type fields are not available in the current public extract and must be acquired or flagged as undisclosed.
